استقصينا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْصَيْنَا (istaqṣaynā) /is.taq.sˤaj.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اُسْتُقْصِينَا (ustuqṣīnā) /us.tuq.sˤiː.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
